note: Demo rounds import the pack fixtures (sourceFixtureId); their finite round dictionaries and optima are kept as regression data and shown as the optional word bank. Practice rounds are original: endpoints chosen by the author, optimum proved by BFS over ESDB membership, and a route of the same length using only familiar (SCOWL size-35) words is stored as the example. Not yet human-reviewed.
